content.text:
At 5 months Theo's just a few weeks away - Health Canada's window is around 6 months, and the readiness signs to watch for are sitting with minimal support, losing the tongue-thrust reflex, and showing interest in food. First foods can be iron-rich purees or soft mashed foods, introduced one at a time - confirm timing with your provider since every baby's readiness differs a little.
